reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount with the existing exported getScheduledAmount, which already resolves missing, single and ranged amounts for the other consumers.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the API field is a single call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, where the API's external schedule shape is built.

scope.why: Only the type field, one mapping line, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: The API value follows the app's rule automatically whenever getScheduledAmount changes.
